newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Agan Q3 net up at 12.9 mln shekels.
newsitem.headline: Agan Q3 net up at 12.9 mln shekels.

text.p: Agan Chemical Manufacturers Ltd, a subsidiary of Makhteshim Chemical Works Ltd.
The third quarter includes for the first time the financial results of its acquisitions in Brazil and Spain as well as a new distribution company set up in Argentina, Agan said in a statement.
Agan and Makhteshim purchased 49 percent of the Spain-based manufacturer and distributor of crop-protection chemicals Aragonesas Agro SA and 49 percent of Brazil's Herbitechnica.

Agan said South America was viewed as an important market for the company and it plans to increase its activities there in coming years. The company noted that Herbitechnica will invest $6 million in a new synthesising plant, which will begin operations by the end of 1997.
In the nine-month period Agan's investments rose to 103 million shekels from 48 million a year earlier.

The company said sales of crop protection products grew 34 percent in the third quarter to $45.4 million. Multi-year distribution agreements in North America will take effect in the fourth quarter, leading to a rise in 1996 sales there.
Sales of aroma chemicals in the third quarter rose 21 percent to $9.9 million.
